meth A put Uriah Winter into play. she has moved to meth C.
meth A plays Banishment calling Uriah whos' uncontrolled reigon does
she go to?

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:



The original influencing Methuselah's uncontrolled region.

Pertinent card text on Banishment:
"breaking any temporary control effects"

Banishment [DS:U2, FN:PS, CE:PTo/PV, KMW:PAn2, LoB:PG]
Cardtype: Political Action
Choose a younger ready vampire. Successful referendum means that the
chosen vampire is moved to the uncontrolled region (breaking any
temporary control effects). The vampire is uncontrolled. Any cards and
counters on that vampire stay with him or her (but they are out of
play as long as the vampire remains uncontrolled).
Artist: Steve Casper

Also:

# Temporary control effects are ended if the vampire is Banished, as
normal, so the vampire would be placed in his previous (permanent)
controller's uncontrolled region. [RTR 20000501]

Messages.Author: Thrall of Arika
Messages.Body:


Such cards change controllers permanently. Temporary control will be
stated on the card that gives you control (such as Temptation or
Spirit Marionette). So no, you cannot auction away your vampires and
then Banish them back to yourself.

Chris, Thrall of Arika
